summary: This clinical trial is studying participants with pre-diabetes who have problems with how their bodies handle sugar, known as impaired fasting glucose and impaired glucose tolerance. Researchers want to see how different study drugs affect insulin and blood sugar levels over time. The sponsor for this study is The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio. There are 700 participants enrolled in this Recruiting trial, which has No phase.

facts.sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio
